pages.text: Some of the fruit grown in the mod can be turned into jam.$(br2)It's a fairly simple way of getting another use out of berries and cherries once you've got a decent harvest.

pages.title: Jams
pages.text: There are three jams: Blackberry Jam, Blueberry Jam and Cherry Jam.$(br2)Each one is made from its corresponding fruit.
Crafting:$\(br\)Blackberry Jam: Blackberries + Glass Bottle$\(br\)Blueberry Jam: Blueberries + Glass Bottle$\(br\)Cherry Jam: Cherries + Glass Bottle.
